answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 933 Country: India Title: I am an Indian citizen. Can I take education loan from a non-Islamic bank inspite of knowing that I have to give the interest? - I have no other way to fund my higher education (MBA from a Australia). Please do mention any Islamic bank which can give me education loan in an Islamic way for my higher education (MBA) from US/Australia. Question: I am an Indian citizen. Can I take education loan from a non-Islamic bank inspite of knowing that I have to give the interest? - I have no other way to fund my higher education (MBA from a Australia). Please do mention any Islamic bank which can give me education loan in an Islamic way for my higher education (MBA) from US/Australia. Answer ID: 933 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 472=460/N) (1) You can not; since giving and taking of interest is sternly prohibited in Islam: واحل اللہ البیع و حرم الربوا (الآیة) وقال: یا ایھا الذین آمنوا اتقوا اللہ وذروا ما بقی من الربوا ان کنتم مؤمنین، فان لم تفعلوا فاذنوا بحرب من اللہ و رسولہ (الآیة) (2) We do not know any Islamic bank in India . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
